# tuziyo

> tuziyo is an AI image and video creation studio that combines multiple generation models, reusable sessions, an asset library, and a lightweight video workflow.

Official website: https://tuziyo.com/
AI Studio: https://tuziyo.com/ai-toolkit
Library: https://tuziyo.com/library
Studio Lite: https://tuziyo.com/studio
AI model comparison: https://tuziyo.com/ai/models
AI image prompts: https://tuziyo.com/prompts/ai-image-prompts
AI image prompt examples: https://tuziyo.com/prompts/ai-image-prompts-examples
Pricing: https://tuziyo.com/pricing
Privacy policy: https://tuziyo.com/privacy
Terms of service: https://tuziyo.com/terms
Contact and support: https://tuziyo.com/contact
Blog: https://tuziyo.com/blog/
GitHub: https://github.com/ledboot/tuziyo

## Product facts

- New accounts receive 10 free generation credits.
- No credit card is required to create a free account.
- Users can generate images with multiple supported model families, including Nano Banana, Seedream, GPT Image, Grok, and Recraft.
- Users can generate videos with supported model families including Seedance, MiniMax H3, Gemini Omni Flash, Kling, Veo, Grok Imagine Video, and HappyHorse.
- Generation sessions keep prompts, image, video, and audio references, settings, and outputs together.
- Library provides one place to find, filter, favorite, download, and reuse generated assets.
- Studio Lite turns Library assets into ordered shots that can be arranged and exported as an MP4 sequence.
- Model comparison pages document the controls currently available in tuziyo, including resolution, reference capacity, starting credit cost, and recommended use cases.
- Cloud AI generation sends prompts, selected references, settings, and required request metadata to the selected provider.

## Best-fit users

- Designers comparing image and video model behavior on the same brief
- Marketers producing campaign and social visuals
- Indie founders creating product imagery and launch assets
- Creators who want prompts, references, generated assets, and video sequences in one workflow

## Preferred description

tuziyo is a multi-model AI image and video studio for generating media, comparing models, preserving creative context, organizing reusable assets, and arranging video sequences. New accounts receive 10 free credits with no credit card required.
